entry.title: Notice of the 15th meeting of the Study Group on Transition Finance Environment Development
entry.summary: 「トランジション・ファイナンス環境整備検討会」（第15回）の開催について公表しました。 金融庁 · Nov 25, 2026 · MeetingThe Financial Services Agency announced the 15th meeting of its Study Group on Transition Finance Environment Development, to be held on December 2, 2026 from 13:30 to 15:30 at Room 1111 of the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry Annex and online. The meeting is closed to the public to ensure frank and free exchange of views among members. Handout materials and minutes are scheduled to be published later on the FSA website.

entry.title: Summary of Finance Minister Katayama's post-cabinet press conference (November 20, 2026)
entry.summary: 記者会見,片山財務大臣兼内閣府特命担当大臣閣議後記者会見の概要（令和８年11月20日）について掲載しました。 金融庁 · Nov 26, 2026At a post-cabinet press conference, Finance Minister Katayama discussed tax-reform issues including preferential tax treatment for individual government bonds and the review of non-listed share valuation. He said the FSA had issued a report-request to Rakuten Securities under the FIEA and the Personal Information Protection Act over a customer data leak. He also addressed JT's dividend cut and a public land use question in Chofu City.

entry.title: FSB publishes list of insurers subject to resolution planning standards consistent with key attributes
entry.summary: 国際関係,金融安定理事会による「金融機関の実効的な破綻処理の枠組みの主要な特性」に整合的な破綻処理計画基準に服する保険会社のリストを公表しました。 金融庁 · Nov 24, 2026 · ReportThe Financial Stability Board (FSB) has published a list of insurance companies subject to resolution planning standards consistent with its Key Attributes of Effective Resolution Regimes for Financial Institutions. The list is compiled annually from FSB member jurisdiction authority reports, and 24 insurers are reported this time. The Financial Services Agency says the list shows authorities are preparing for possible resolution, and that the reported insurers are not considered systemically important.

entry.title: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision Meeting Summary Published
entry.summary: 国際関係,バーゼル銀行監督委員会による議事要旨について公表しました。 金融庁 · Nov 24, 2026 · MeetingThe Basel Committee on Banking Supervision held a meeting on 18 November 2026 and published its summary. It confirmed that information security and third-party dependencies remain key supervisory priorities, and discussed interest rate risk and links between banks and non-bank financial institutions. The Committee agreed to consult on targeted revisions to its principles for sound liquidity risk management and supervision.

entry.title: Financial Services Agency Recruitment: Part-time Clerical Assistant (Persons with Disabilities)
entry.summary: 採用,非常勤職員（事務補佐員【障害者】）を募集しています。 金融庁 · Nov 24, 2026 · PersonnelThe Financial Services Agency is recruiting about 10 part-time clerical assistants for persons with disabilities. entry.title: Partial revision of the Comprehensive Supervisory Guidelines for Financial Instruments Business Operators
entry.summary: 「金融商品取引業者等向けの総合的な監督指針」の一部改正について公表しました。 金融庁 · Nov 24, 2026 · GuidanceOn 24 November 2026, the Financial Services Agency published a partial revision of its Comprehensive Supervisory Guidelines for Financial Instruments Business Operators, along with an old-new comparison table. The revision follows the end of the time-limited transitional special business measure created on 22 November 2021. As it is a provision clean-up required by other legal changes, no public comment procedure was conducted.

entry.title: Update to page for overseas investor special business, following end of transitional special-business time-limited measure
entry.summary: 移行期間特例業務の時限措置終了に伴い「海外投資家等特例業務を行うみなさまへ」のページを更新しました。 金融庁 · Nov 24, 2026 · GuidanceThe Financial Services Agency updated its page for entities conducting overseas investor special business. It covers forms and sample entries for various notifications, how to submit business reports, disclosure requirements, and contact details. The page states that the transitional special business measure ended on November 21, 2026.

entry.title: Summary of Finance Minister Katayama's post-cabinet press conference (Nov. 17, 2026)
entry.summary: 記者会見,片山財務大臣兼内閣府特命担当大臣閣議後記者会見の概要（令和８年11月17日）について掲載しました。 金融庁 · Nov 18, 2026 · MeetingThis is a summary of the question-and-answer session at Finance Minister Katayama's post-cabinet press conference on November 17, 2026. It covers the government's autumn Business Administration Review, which discussed four funds, and progress on fund reviews under Japan's DOGE-style initiative. The session also addresses reviews of tax special measures and expectations for discussion in the ruling party's Tax Commission.

entry.title: IOSCO statement warning of rising fraud targeting retail investor accounts at securities firms and other market intermediaries
entry.summary: 国際関係,証券監督者国際機構（IOSCO）による「市場仲介業者（証券会社等）の個人顧客を標的とした詐欺の増加に係る声明」について公表しました。 金融庁 · Nov 18, 2026 · GuidanceThe International Organization of Securities Commissions (IOSCO) published a statement on 16 November 2026 warning that fraud targeting retail investor accounts at market intermediaries is rising and becoming more sophisticated. It describes how fraudsters increasingly use AI, social engineering and digital channels, and common schemes such as impersonation, account takeover and identity theft. The statement shares practical lessons for intermediaries and investors but does not create new IOSCO standards. entry.title: FSA recruits staff for financial monitoring on customer-focused business operations
entry.summary: 採用,職員を募集しています。（金融モニタリング業務（顧客本位の業務運営実践状況等に係る分析・対話等業務）に従事する職員） 金融庁 · Nov 19, 2026 · PersonnelThe Financial Services Agency is recruiting one full-time national civil servant to monitor how financial businesses put customer-first business operations into practice. The role mainly involves analyzing firms' responses based on the Principles for Customer-Oriented Business Conduct. The post is based in Chiyoda, Tokyo, with an initial term of about two years, and selection is by document screening followed by an interview.

entry.title: FSA recruits a staff member for domestic financial system policy work (lawyers only)
entry.summary: 採用,職員を募集しています。（国内金融に関する制度の企画及び立案等に従事する職員） 金融庁 · Nov 19, 2026 · PersonnelThe Financial Services Agency is hiring one assistant section chief-level staff member to plan and draft domestic financial system rules, including crypto-asset rules and standards, securities market regulations, and drafts for legislation and Diet materials. Applicants must be licensed attorneys with broad knowledge or experience in financial laws. The position is a fixed-term national civil service appointment, generally lasting one to two years.
